description: PART 2d: make BTC, ETH, SOL and XRP clickable assets whose charts render tick-by-tick like ARV/BTC. Today ingest_prices() hardcodes only ETH+SOL into asset_candles and market.php only serves ARV candles (arv_candles) plus a watchlist snapshot; there is NO per-asset candle endpoint and XRP is absent. Add XRP, make BTC chartable as an asset, add per-asset candle backfill+rollup, expose a per-asset candle API, and add a frontend asset-selection UI that reuses the same live-feed tick-by-tick chart wiring from FEAT-003. This is the largest feature and depends on FEAT-003 (live-candle chart plumbing). Independent of FEAT-002/004 except that it reuses their patterns.
steps: Add XRP to the config. In arv-config.js WATCHLIST add an XRP entry ({ key:'XRP', name:'XRP', colour:'#...', symbols:{ binance:'XRPUSDT', okx:'XRP-USDT', coinbase:'XRP-USD', kraken:'XRPUSD', coingecko:'ripple' } }). Verify each per-source symbol is valid (Kraken uses XRPUSD; Coinbase XRP-USD; OKX XRP-USDT; Binance XRPUSDT). Also add ETH/SOL kraken ws symbols and XRP to js/feed.js kraken.wsSymbols map ({ XBTUSD:'BTC/USD', ETHUSD:'ETH/USD', SOLUSD:'SOL/USD', XRPUSD:'XRP/USD' }).

Generalise ingestion in api/_feed.php: replace the hardcoded foreach(['ETH','SOL']) in ingest_prices() with a list derived from the config watchlist assets (ETH, SOL, XRP) - keep BTC ingested by its dedicated path (it already writes asset_candles for BTC). So asset_candles ends up holding BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP 1m candles.

Add per-asset backfill + rollup so the non-ARV assets have chartable history and larger timeframes, mirroring the ARV logic: add a backfill_asset_tf(assetKey, tf, days) (or extend backfill_tf to take an asset target writing to asset_candles instead of arv_candles) using fetch_candles_range(assetKey, tf, from); add a rollup for asset_candles larger tfs (5m/15m/1h/4h/1D/1W) analogous to rollup_all() but per asset_key writing to asset_candles. Wire these into the auto-backfill/cron path OR into an operator backfill action; keep it paced (usleep) like the existing paths. Note the deep-history honesty limit from FEAT-004 applies to these assets too (daily/weekly deep, minute recent).

Expose a per-asset candle API. In api/market.php add an action (e.g. action=asset_candles&key=ETH&tf=1m&days=..&limit=..) that validates key against an allowlist (BTC,ETH,SOL,XRP), validates tf against the timeframe list, and reads asset_candles WHERE asset_key=? AND tf=? (mirroring handle_candles which reads arv_candles). Return the same {tf,count,from,to,candles:[{t,o,h,l,c,v}]} shape. Also extend handle_watchlist() to include XRP (add 'XRP'=>'XRP' to the loop map).
Add a JS API function in js/api.js: assetCandles(key, tf, days, limit) that calls request('market','asset_candles',{method:'GET',query:{key,tf,days,limit}}), alongside the existing candles().

Add the asset-selection UI + chart. On the page where charts live (trade.html and/or dashboard/portfolio - choose trade.html as the primary trading chart, and/or a market page), add clickable asset tabs/buttons for ARV, BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP. When ARV is selected use api.candles() (arv_candles) as today; when a coin is selected use api.assetCandles(key,...) and price/scale in USD (assets are quoted in USD in asset_candles). Reuse the SAME chart component and the SAME live tick-by-tick update wiring from FEAT-003, but for a coin update the last candle directly from feed.priceUsd(key) (no ARV conversion needed - the coin chart is in USD), and for ARV keep the BTC->ARV conversion. js/feed.js already subscribes to all BASKET+WATCHLIST assets (allAssets()), and now that XRP is in WATCHLIST the feed will stream XRP trades too - so feed.onTick/feed.priceUsd('XRP') will work. Confirm handleTrade only pushes BASKET (BTC) to the tape but updates state.prices for ALL assets (it does: state.prices[t.key] is set unconditionally), so per-asset live prices are available for every selected asset.

Ensure each selected asset's chart updates tick-by-tick: on asset selection, load its historical candles then subscribe to feed ticks filtered to that asset key, updating the last bar in place (append new bar at tf-bucket boundary), identical to the ARV wiring. Switching assets should tear down the previous tick subscription cleanly (feed.onTick returns an unsubscribe function - use it).

Do NOT let non-BTC assets affect ARV pricing or the money path: asset_candles for ETH/SOL/XRP are display-only (weight 0), exactly as the existing comments in _feed.php and market.php insist. The index still tracks BTC at weight 1.0.
acceptance_criteria: arv-config.js WATCHLIST includes XRP with valid per-source symbols, and js/feed.js kraken.wsSymbols includes XRP/USD (and ETH/SOL).

api/_feed.php ingests ETH, SOL and XRP (derived from the watchlist, not a hardcoded ['ETH','SOL']) into asset_candles, and provides per-asset backfill + rollup writing to asset_candles for the chart timeframes.
api/market.php serves a per-asset candle action (allowlisted key BTC/ETH/SOL/XRP, validated tf) returning the standard candle shape, and handle_watchlist() includes XRP.

The frontend has clickable asset selection (ARV, BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP); selecting a coin loads its candles and updates its last candle tick-by-tick from the live js/feed.js stream (USD for coins, BTC->ARV conversion for ARV), reusing the FEAT-003 chart component; switching assets unsubscribes the previous tick listener.
ETH/SOL/XRP remain weight 0 and never enter the index or the money path.
verification: `php -l api/_feed.php && php -l api/market.php` report no syntax errors.
`node --check js/api.js && node --check js/feed.js && node --check js/pages/trade.js` (and any other edited page) report no parse errors.

`node -e "globalThis.window={};require('./arv-config.js');var w=globalThis.ARV_CONFIG.WATCHLIST.map(function(a){return a.key});console.log(w);if(w.indexOf('XRP')<0)throw'XRP missing'"` prints the watchlist including XRP.
`grep -n "asset_candles\|action=='asset_candles'\|'asset_candles'\|XRP" api/market.php api/_feed.php` shows the per-asset endpoint, XRP in the watchlist loop, and the generalised ingest.
`grep -n "assetCandles" js/api.js` and `grep -n "assetCandles\|feed.priceUsd\|onTick" js/pages/trade.js` show the wiring.

MANUAL/DEFERRED (record in findings): per-asset ingest/backfill and live streaming cannot be exercised without live exchange access + MySQL; verify on a live environment that asset_candles fills for BTC/ETH/SOL/XRP and that each asset's chart streams tick-by-tick. State this limit clearly.
